github-templates.description: Issue templates, PR templates, and default PR template. Drop into any GitHub repository.

community-health.description: Standard community health files — CONTRIBUTING, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, SECURITY, CHANGELOG, CODEOWNERS. Essential for public and open source repositories.

readme-templates.description: README templates for four common project types — app, library, CLI, and API. Copy and rename the appropriate template to README.md.

labels-script.description: Shell script that creates the standard GitHub label set via the GitHub CLI. Run once after creating a new repository. Requires gh CLI.

git-standards.description: Reference docs for branching strategy, Conventional Commits, PR conventions, and semantic versioning. Pairs well with github-templates.

github-standards.description: Reference docs for GitHub labels, issues, milestones, and PR sidebar usage. Pairs well with github-templates and labels-script.

dev-standards.description: Reference docs for environment variables, TDD, and software licenses.
